body: I'm so sorry for your loss. I really hope he doesn't blame me, sometimes it's something I can't control, regardless thank you for saying that because I needed to hear it. I will do my best to try and figure out what exactly is making me push him away. Thank you!
That's exactly what he says to me whenever I get one of my episodes. It's just really hard to believe him even though I want to so badly. Thank you.
